name: Volvo Settings Shell

preserveRules: Keep the part catalog described as the only active Volvo settings surface

acceptanceCriteria: Selecting Volvo settings opens the Part Catalog surface directly

validationHints: Confirm the part catalog page loads the Volvo part list and still launches add, edit, deactivate, and component-review actions
